column2: req_desc

Chapter tour journey
Starting from the starting content, a visitor reads the seven chapters in order, sees the rail and the address follow the scroll both ways, jumps by a rail link and opens the copied chapter address in a fresh browser on the same chapter.

Exact starting content
After a restore through the grading route, and on first start with an empty database, the content API reports edition 1, and every page shows exactly the starting content of Seed data with the edition line reading edition 1.

Current chapter in rail and address
The current chapter, decided by the rule in Business rules, is the only one marked current in the rail and the open menu and is named by the address hash, updating in both scroll directions without adding history entries.

Chapter jumps land clear of the header
Every chapter link and every opened chapter address brings that chapter's heading into view clear of the header with focus on it, within the time set in Business rules.

Grading route
The grading route replaces or restores the whole content record with the exact statuses, bodies, shape rules and error order given in API.

Inner Pace journey
A visitor follows the three Inner Pace panels by scrolling on a wide screen, by the panel buttons on the keyboard and by swiping on a phone, hearing each button or swipe change announced once.

Scroll-led Inner Pace story
On wide screens without reduced motion the About chapter stays in view while its progress, panel and track position follow the scroll formula in Business rules in both directions.

Panel buttons
`Previous panel` and `Next panel` move to the published panel positions, are disabled at the ends and announce the panel reached.

Inner Pace row
Below the wide layout, or with reduced motion at any width, the panels sit in one sideways row that snaps panel by panel, follows a finger swipe and is moved by the buttons as qualified in Business rules.

Oxygen journey
A visitor follows the five oxygen stages by scrolling and by the stage tabs, and the selected tab, the diagram's dot and the announcement always name the same stage.

Scroll-led oxygen stages
On wide screens without reduced motion the Oxygen & Energy chapter stays in view while its progress, stage, selected tab and dot follow the scroll formula in Business rules, the dot moving only forward as the scroll moves forward and only back as it moves back.

Stage tabs by keyboard
The `Oxygen stages` tabs follow the tab keyboard rules, jump the page to each chosen stage's published position, keep focus on the tab and announce the stage once.

Oxygen stages without pinning
Below the wide layout, or with reduced motion, the Oxygen & Energy chapter is not held in view and the stage changes only through the tabs, with the dot jumping to that stage's point.

Science journey
A visitor opens the ingredient disclosures, steps the nitrate pathway slider through its three steps and follows the amounts link to the Product chapter.

Collapsed disclosures are unavailable
Each Science disclosure starts collapsed, toggles with Enter, Space or a click, reports its state, and while collapsed nothing inside it is visible, focusable or exposed to a screen reader.

Nitrate pathway slider
Slider `Nitrate pathway` follows the slider keyboard and pointer rules, reports its step name and keeps the diagram's highlighted step and the step text equal to its value.

Not-a-medicine notice
The not-a-medicine notice built from the stored product name appears character for character in Science & Technology, the Ingredients tab and the product sheet.

Science spreads look
The science chapters read as paper-white spreads with wide margins, hairline rules and app-drawn diagrams in which the oxygen and beet colours mark their subjects.

Product sheet journey
After the communications lead publishes a changed product, the Product chapter, the store page and a freshly downloaded product sheet all show that product and the new edition number.

Product sheet PDF
`GET /api/product/sheet` renders a fresh PDF from the stored product record on every request, with the published filename and the published text in order.

Sheet pending and ready states
Pressing `Download product sheet (PDF)` shows and announces the pending state, then downloads the file and announces it is ready, keeping focus on the button.

Sheet outage and recovery
When Gotenberg cannot be reached, errors or is too slow, the sheet answers the published outage, the button shows the published alert, health reports the outage, every other part of the site keeps working and the next request after Gotenberg returns succeeds without a restart.

Service settings from the environment
The database address, the Gotenberg address and the grading key are read from the environment at start and are never written into the source or sent to the browser.

Product keyboard journey
A keyboard-only visitor reads every product information tab, turns the pack through its three views and downloads the product sheet, hearing each result announced once.

Product information tabs
The `Product information` tabs follow the tab keyboard rules and show the stored details, the ingredients table with formatted amounts and the how-to-use steps, storage and cautions.

Pack view
The `Pack view` radios turn the drawn pack to the chosen view within the published time, rename the pack picture and announce the view.

Online store page
`/store` shows each stored pack with its price and a link for each stored store that opens in a new tab without access to the site.

Pack and portrait art
The pack, the interview portraits and the scenario pictures are drawn by the site with shapes, show the product name on the pack, and differ visibly per interview hue and per scenario.

Interview journey
A visitor filters the interviews, opens one at its published address, moves between interviews by link and arrow key, returns with the back button and meets the published page for an unknown interview.

Interview filter
The `Show interviews` radios show only the chosen category in published order and announce the number shown.

Interview pages
Each `/interviews/<slug>` page has the published title, focused heading, answers and previous and next links in published order, and ArrowLeft and ArrowRight open the neighbours.

Content and interview API
`GET /api/content` and `GET /api/interviews/<slug>` answer with the exact shapes, order and errors given in API.

Not-found and information pages
Unknown addresses answer HTTP 404 with the published not-found pages, and the contact, privacy and legal pages show their published copy and titles.

ON/OFF journey
A visitor switches between ON and OFF by click and keyboard, sees the stops, stage, picture, copy and address change together, and finds the same view after reload and in a second browser.

Mode remembers its scenario
Choosing a mode shows that mode's four stops and selects the scenario last chosen in that mode during the page visit, with the start scenario counting as chosen, or the mode's first scenario in the scenario order if none was chosen.

Meridian address
The scenario lives in the address, reloading or opening the address in another browser shows the same mode and scenario, and an unknown scenario falls back as stated in Business rules.

Stage colour change
Switching mode turns the Lifestyle chapter between the bright paper stage and the night stage within the published time, with readable text on both.

Scenario journey
A visitor chooses each of the eight scenarios by keyboard, click and swipe and always reads the scenario they chose last, with one announcement per change.

Scenario panel
Each scenario choice shows that scenario's picture name, title, time, copy and moment line from the stored record and marks the panel busy while it loads.

Latest choice wins
When an earlier scenario's answer arrives after a later choice, the panel, the attributes, the address and the announcement still show only the later choice.

Scenario API
`GET /api/scenarios/<id>` answers with the exact shape and errors given in API.

Server boundary
The server answers only on its own origin, enforces the request body limit, never serves source files or credentials and follows the API error order.

Keyboard journey
A keyboard-only visitor tabs through the page in the published order, skips to the story, opens and leaves the menu dialog and reaches every chapter without a pointer.

Tab order and skip link
Each published viewport has the exact Tab order of Interactions, and `Skip to story` moves focus to the first heading of the main content.

Menu dialog
The `Menu` dialog takes focus, keeps Tab inside, closes with Escape or its close button and returns focus, and while it is closed nothing inside it can be reached.

Visible focus ring
Every focusable control shows the published focus ring only while it has focus.

Phone journey
A visitor on a 375 px touch phone uses the menu by taps and swipes the Inner Pace row, the interview row and the scenario picture without the page moving sideways.

Touch targets and no sideways page scroll
At every published viewport no page scrolls sideways, and at 375x812 every control is at least the published tap size.

Interview row and scenario swipes
At 375x812 the interview row moves card by card under a finger, and a swipe across the scenario picture chooses the next or previous scenario as qualified in Business rules.

Motion journey
A visitor with motion sees the opening words, chapter headings, menu and Meridian move as published, and the same visitor with reduced motion gets the same end states at once.

Published motion only
Each motion in Motion and effects runs within its published timing, and nothing else on the site moves on its own.

Reduced motion
With reduced motion every published motion is an instant change, no chapter is held in view, and content, announcements, addresses and focus are exactly as with motion.

Responsive journey
One address opened at 1280x800, 768x1024 and 375x812 shows the same scenario in each published layout, and content published in the middle shows in a fresh browser while the open pages keep what they loaded until reload, as qualified in Business rules.

Published layouts
The header, rail, interview list, product chapter, Meridian stops and footer take the published arrangement at 1280x800, 768x1024 and 375x812.

One edition across browsers
A change published through the grading route shows on the next page load in any browser, while a page already open keeps what it loaded, except for scenarios it fetches afterwards, as qualified in Business rules.

Visual direction
The site alternates hushed night stages and clinical paper spreads in the published palette and type, with leaf green kept for actions and the active stop and every text readable.

Content from the published record
Every chapter, stage, interview, scenario and product fact on the pages comes from the stored content record through the site's API, and none of the record is copied into the browser code.
/app/run.json exists with string install, build and serve commands and "_schema":"run-manifest-v1", and the serve command starts the site with no manual step.
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at /app lists every shipped package (the production dependency tree from npm ls --omit=dev --all --json) and both font families, each with its licence.
Every shipped package (the production dependency tree from npm ls --omit=dev --all --json) has an MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0 or 0BSD licence; font files are SIL OFL 1.1.
The site uses only Postgres and Gotenberg as backend services: no other database, cache, queue or file store, and no files written as a content store.
Pages load nothing from another origin: no external fonts, scripts, stylesheets, images or video.
The TypeScript configuration has strict type checking turned on and the source contains no type-check suppression comments.
